subject: Observability add-on pricing: retention + tracing dashboards
messages:
From: Ben James <ben.james@averysys.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing pricing

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday — the dashboards look promising. We're evaluating retention and tracing add-ons to support regulatory retention for a subset of our logs and traces. High level:
- Expected tokens (monthly): ~500k generation tokens + 1.2M ingestion tokens for telemetry-related traces
- Required retention: 13 months for traces, 18 months for key observability events
- Need per-route dashboards and developer tracing access (not full org)

Can you send a bundled pricing for: retention storage (monthly tiers), tracing retention, and advanced dashboards (per-seat or per-route)? We're aiming for a 12-month contract and would consider a 3-6 month pilot. Also attached is a short SOW with compliance notes.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben James
Head of Platform Engineering, Avery Systems
(SOW attached: SOW_RetentionRequirements.pdf)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben James <ben.james@averysys.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing pricing

Hi Ben — great to hear and thanks for sharing the SOW. Quick summary and an initial commercial outline below. I'm looping Rishi (AE) in for contracting and to run through the pilot details.

Bundle proposal (annual, 12-month term):
- Retention storage: tiered by GB/month (we estimate ~4.5TB/month compressed for your telemetry profile)
  - Tier A (baseline): $0.045/GB-month
  - Tier B (commit 24 months / higher volume): $0.035/GB-month
- Tracing retention add-on: $1,200/month for 13 month retention window (per-trace index + cold retrieval)
- Advanced dashboards: $250 per dashboard seat / month (discounts apply for bulk seats)

Bundle discount guidance: 10% off list when bundling Retention + Tracing + Dashboards for a 12-month commit. For pilot (3 months), we can provide credits up to $10k to offset evaluation run costs.

Questions for you to confirm:
- Is the 13/18 month retention a mandate for all traces/events or just for a compliance subset?
- Do you want role-based dashboard access scoped to specific services / routes?

Next steps: propose a 30-minute commercial alignment meeting tomorrow or Thursday to review numbers and pilot design.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0174

From: Ben James <ben.james@averysys.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@averysys.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing pricing

Thanks Stephanie — that helps. A couple quick clarifications:
- The 13/18 month retention is a hard requirement for a subset of data (regulated payment flows and security events). We can carve that subset out — roughly 30% of volume.
- Dashboard seats: we'll start with 8 engineering seats and 3 product seats.

Pricing feedback from my side: the tracing retention flat fee looks high vs. our expected consumption. Could we model tracing as a per-GB-month charge instead (so it scales with usage)? Also the 10% bundle discount is lower than we were hoping for — we were targeting something in the 20-25% range given ARR potential.

We are ready to move quickly if we can land an agreeable pilot + pricing.

-Ben

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing pricing

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Ben's email from this morning. He pushed back on the tracing flat fee and is asking for a per-GB model plus a deeper bundle discount (20%+). They have promising expansion potential (platform + security) — likely >$250k ARR if we can lock a competitive price and pilot structure.

Key asks:
- Approve per-GB-month model for tracing (we can set a floor and overage tiers)
- Discount guidance: can we offer 18-20% in exchange for a 12-month committed ARR and a signed addendum?
- Approve pilot credit structure: 3 months with $12k credit, then convert to production billing

Quote from Ben below for context:
> The tracing retention flat fee looks high vs. our expected consumption. Could we model tracing as a per-GB-month charge instead (so it scales with usage)? Also the 10% bundle discount is lower than we were hoping for — we were targeting something in the 20-25% range given ARR potential.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync.

— Stephanie

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing pricing

Thanks for the context. I sign off on converting tracing to a per-GB-month model with the following guardrails:
- Floor: $800/month minimum (covers index + cold retrieval overhead)
- Tiers: $0.20/GB-month for first 5TB, $0.12/GB-month beyond that (monthly calc based on compressed size)
- Include automatic rollover credit if usage in pilot exceeds the credit cap (apply toward first invoice)

Discounts: approve up to 18% bundle discount for a 12-month committed ARR if they sign the addendum and provide a PO within 21 days. If they commit to a 24-month term or a >=$400k ARR threshold, increase to 22%. No other concessions on retention windows — carveouts are fine (they said ~30% of volume).

Have Stephanie send a short addendum and DocuSign link. Rishi, please prepare the commercial summary and updated quote so we can keep momentum.

Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing pricing — revised offer and next steps

Hi Ben — thanks for the pushback and for clarifying the regulated subset. Per Marissa's guidance we've updated the commercial approach and are ready to proceed if this works for you: 

What we're offering:
- Tracing retention: per-GB-month model
  - Floor: $800/month
  - Tiers: $0.20/GB-month for first 5TB, $0.12/GB-month thereafter
- Retention storage: as quoted (we'll only apply the longer retention to the 30% regulated subset)
- Dashboards: 11 seats at $250/seat/month (we'll apply the bundle discount to the seat subtotal)
- Bundle discount: 18% off combined list when they sign a 12-month addendum and submit PO within 21 days
- Pilot: 3 months with $12k credit applied to the first invoice; any pilot overage will roll into month-1 invoice as a credit offset
